recent_accepted.summary:
The constructor raises PermitError("ledger_chain_broken_line_2").

Deleting the original line 2 leaves line 1 (prev null, hash H1) followed by the old line 3, whose previous_event_hash is H2. read() has previous = H1 at that point, so the chain require() fails on line number 2.
